messages:
maya: Heads up: planning to enable aurora-7b-v3 in catalog tonight. Change window 23:00-00:30 UTC. Canary plan 5% -> 25% -> 100% (20m steps).

maya: Need fallback reorder: quant-v2, baseline-13b-ff, safe-fallback-6b. Pin eu to aurora-7b-v3@2026-03-21-01 during cutover.

deploybot: Queued job: `/deploy catalog enable aurora-7b-v3 --canary 5,25,100 --window 2026-03-21T23:00Z/2026-03-22T00:30Z --pin eu:aurora-7b-v3@2026-03-21-01`

ben: +1. Add auto-rollback if error_rate > 1% OR p95 > 800ms for 5m.

carla: Agree. I'll run warmup at 22:30 UTC to prime caches. Warmup snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/warmup -d '{"model":"aurora-7b-v3","prompts":["Hi","Summarize x"]}'
```

ryan: Ensure quant-v2 capacity in eu-west-1; if not, route to baseline-13b-ff before safe-fallback-6b. Add region-aware fallback check.

jamie: I'll assemble observability salvo: dashboard catalog/aurora-cutover, alerts: error_rate>1% 5m OR p95>800ms 5m -> rollback. Posting alert IDs shortly.

ops-bot: Incident channel #inc-aurora-rollout created. Runbook pinned: https://redwood/runbooks/aurora-rollout. On-call: @jamie.

liz: Drafting internal release note: "Enable aurora-7b-v3 (pinned in EU) with updated fallback ordering; improved latency." Will include model hash + pin info.

maya: @deploybot schedule warmup 22:30 and start canary at 23:00. Stagger regions: eu -> na -> apac with 10m offsets.

deploybot: Warmup scheduled 2026-03-21T22:30:00Z. Canary start 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Stagger offsets applied. Will post status updates.

ben: If rollback fires, roll to catalog-stable@LATEST and notify PMs + eng leads. Increment rollback counter in notes.

carla: Reserving ephemeral slots for 25% canary in eu-west-1.

ryan: Also add shallow backoff on client retries for the first hour to reduce cascade pressure.

jamie: Standby 22:45-00:45 UTC. Will execute rollback play if alerts trigger and post a summary.

maya: Thanks all. Locking plan. Reminders: 60m/30m/5m before warmup.

deploybot: Reminders scheduled.

maya: Call out here if anything changes. Otherwise we cut at 23:00 UTC.

ben: +1, good luck.

carla: I'll monitor infra during the window.

jamie: Oncall acknowledged.
